items.title: Labor was poised to reveal massive migration cuts, then suddenly delayed
items.description: The ABC understands the cuts to migration numbers are contentious within Labor, but no reason for the delay is given.

items.title: 'Noose is tightening': One Nation's new Victorian leader promoted conspiracy
items.description: The new state One Nation leader warned of a debunked "globalist" plot to control Australians.

items.title: Jetstar to scrap free 7kg carry-on for new overhead luggage fees
items.description: Jetstar has announced it will charge passengers to stow carry-on luggage in overhead lockers from next year, allowing only a small under-seat bag at no extra cost.

items.title: Experts warn 'national tragedy' emerging in latest NAPLAN results
items.description: NAPLAN test scores have revealed one-third of Australian students are not meeting "challenging but reasonable" expectations in literacy and numeracy.

items.title: Gas giant prosecuted after under-reporting toxic emissions
items.description: Japanese gas giant Inpex has been charged by the Northern Territory's environmental regulator for under-reporting the amount of toxic emissions it released from the Ichthys facility near Darwin.

items.title: 'The world must see': Zelenskyy shares video of drone hunting vegetable seller
items.description: Ukraine accuses Russia of committing a war crime after video is released showing a drone chasing down and wounding a vegetable seller in the southern city of Kherson. Footage shows the drone pursuing a man around a van being used as a street stand, before diving towards him and exploding as he ducks for cover behind the vehicle. The man, identified only as Yurii, survived but suffered shock and shrapnel injuries, according to Ukrainian officials.

items.title: Man arrested at Trump golf course carrying ammunition, authorities say
items.description: The man was appearing to monitor security preparations two days ahead of a Trump fundraiser, authorities said.

items.title: High Court throws out reduced sentence for teen who killed Emma Lovell
items.description: The High Court of Australia throws out a reduced sentence handed to a 17-year-old jailed over the murder of Brisbane woman Emma Lovell.

items.title: 'Fitspo content' worse than modelling industry for woman's eating disorder
items.description: The modelling industry was at the root of Isabella Charon's eating disorder but it was an avalanche of "toxic fitspo" content online that fuelled it.

items.title: Grandmother torched own home after late husband left it to someone else
items.description: A grandmother, who burned down the home she'd lived in for decades after being left out of her late husband's will, has been handed a suspended jail sentence.

items.title: Alternative school's founding family banned from senior roles
items.description: The founder and two other senior staff members of an alternative Melbourne school are found unfit to hold a position of authority in the Victorian education system following an investigation by regulators into child safety and governance concerns.

items.title: These 10 Aussie wildflowers have superpowers. Pick your favourite
items.description: Move over waratahs and banksias! These 10 flowers from the unsung understorey are not just pretty faces, they have surprising tricks up their sleeves.

items.title: The problem of Australia's 'beer tax' is well known. Is it time to end it?
items.description: The cost of alcohol is grinding Australia's old pub culture and live music venues into dust. Should we keep forging ahead with six-monthly increases in the beer excise?

items.title: Erectile dysfunction drug may heighten risk of eye disease, study shows
items.description: Men who take a widely-used erectile dysfunction drug to treat an enlarged prostate are "significantly more likely" to develop glaucoma, a new study has found.

items.title: 'A lifelong wound': What happens when kids are parentified
items.description: Eve was an adult when she realised she grew up in a home where the child-adult relationships were reversed.

items.title: Richard Gere's son Homer steps into the spotlight in The Shards
items.description: Netflix's six-episode adaptation of Miles Franklin's beloved novel features former Home and Away star Philippa Northeast as the firey protagonist.

items.title: Travel quiz: Will you pass with flying colours?
items.description: Where would you find the world's longest train tunnel? And how do you spell the name of the second-longest river in the US?

items.title: Police investigate arson on Victorian defence company as 'far-left terror'
items.description: It is the first time Australian authorities have investigated what they consider to be a potential far-left terror attack, motivated by anarchist and revolutionary ideology.

items.title: Corruption probe into Andrews-era firefighters negotiations handed down
items.description: The IBAC report into a bitter pay dispute between the Victorian government and firefighters during the Andrews era found United Firefighters Union boss Peter Marshall had privileged access to government figures, but stopped short of any finding of corrupt conduct.

items.title: High Court rules in favour of native title holders fighting NT water licence
items.description: The High Court decides in favour of native title holders fighting to overturn a water licence that had been granted to a cattle station in Central Australia.

items.title: Live: SpaceX earnings beat estimates but costs balloon
items.description: SpaceX's results beat analyst estimates but the firm is yet to turn a profit. Meanwhile, the Australian share market has started its day higher on hopes the US and Iran will reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Own Australian shares? Reporting season to bring big falls at major companies
items.description: Australia's largest companies will reveal how they performed financially over the next few weeks, against the gloomy backdrop of a property downturn, stubborn inflation, higher interest rates and the Iran war.

items.title: A drifting part of a SpaceX rocket is about to crash into the Moon
items.description: Part of a SpaceX rocket will crash into the Moon, with the impact likely to be seen from Earth.

items.title: Solar costs for business to be slashed under energy scheme expansion
items.description: The federal government is set to announce changes to the Small-scale Renewable Energy scheme in a bid to help businesses install solar systems and close the gap with residential take-up.

items.title: Engineer says 50 years of erosion research being ignored
items.description: A co-author of the first NSW Coastal Protection Act says 50 years of research is being undermined by courts allowing people to protect their own properties at select locations.
